column5: Reentrant settable-oracle callee corrupts deposit share accounting -- ### Summary `Vault.sol:executeDeposit()` calls the deployer-settable `oracle.getPrice()` callee before finalizing share state, so a hostile oracle reenters executeDeposit and mints shares against stale accounting. ### Root Cause In `Vault.sol` executeDeposit reaches an attacker-controlled callee mid-deposit with CEI violated. ### Impact A reentrant deposit drains vault share value -- a direct loss of user funds.
